F-3gzf (Innsbruck, ULB Tirol, Frg. C30): source-assisted reading, made with the image-only first reading, the Digest (Mommsen's text, Latin Library transcription) and the glossed Digestum vetus (Paris 1566) in hand. Lines reread on the images by a research reader: canvas 2 (02_r), all 24 main-text lines and the whole gloss column and upper margin; canvas 0 (01_r), the lower twelve lines of the main column; canvas 3 (02_v), the lower thirteen lines of the main column; canvas 1 (01_v), the upper twelve lines of the main column. Readings that two blind readers did not confirm are marked (?). The gloss of canvases 0, 1 and 3 and all other lines rest on the first reading only. Expansions in parentheses; [..] lost or unread; (?) uncertain. Boxes are native pixels.
